title: Hypothetical: 49% cap on foreign ownership of telecom operators

answers.name: Foreign equity cap of 49% in licensed telecom operators
answers.description: Foreign investors may hold at most 49% of the capital of a licensed telecommunications operator.

notes.c_limitation: If the Schedule inscribed 'foreign equity limited to 49%', the measure would be covered.
notes.x_paragraph: Keeping operators under domestic control is an industrial-policy objective, not an Article XIV ground.
